## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Base engine's reported P&L of +$7,555 (real-fills OPRA 2025-01-02..2026-06-18) assumes qty scaling per J source-of-truth on winner days (6,20,10 contracts) and risk-rules position sizing. Max qty observed: 20 contracts on 5/01. At $1.00 entry premium, 20 contracts require $2,000 capital (20 × $1.00 × 100) under 50% risk cap. Account-size assumption: $2K+ for full qty; $1K paper realizes ~35% headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = 342 trading days (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Selection method: all trading days in OPRA cache. Overfit risk: medium; base engine is product of prior iterations but anchor days (3/342 days) are low-frequency events increasing false positive risk.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not specified in leaderboard; requires Stage-1 backtest to compute OOS/IS Sharpe ratio).
4. **Real-fills:** Top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) confirmed via STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND candidate: engine P&L matches J source-of-truth exactly (+$342, +$470, +$730) as anchor edge_capture unchanged and winners kept. Real-fills simulation on these days shows zero slippage vs BS-sim for these specific trades (per candidate's "preserved as RANGE=no-veto" indicating no structural veto interference).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (base engine maxDD = −$2,273 per STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND candidate, but worst single day not isolated).
   - Max drawdown: −$2,273 (aggregate over 16 months).
   - Blow-up scenario: three consecutive loser-day losses exceeding daily kill switch (−50% of starting equity) triggering forced flat and missed winner-day recovery.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (top-5 days % of P&L not provided in leaderboard for base engine; STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND candidate shows anchor edge_capture unchanged but does not disclose base engine concentration).
